51555713.DESCRIPTION: Inhibition of human cytosolic ThrRS assessed as dissociation constant by isothermal titration calorimetry
51555713.references_previous: Congreve, M.; Chessari, G.; Tisi, D.; Woodhead, A. J. Recent Developments in Fragment-Based Drug Discovery. J. Med. Chem. 2008, 51 (13), 3661–3680.

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The binding affinities of compounds 10a, 10b, and 11 to human cytosolic ThrRS (HcThrRS) were determined by isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) as described previously.22 The experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical, Worcestershire, U.K.). HcThrRS was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, pH 7.5, and concentrated to 10 μM. The ligands were dissolved in the same buffer to a concentration of 100 μM. The protein was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL), and the ligand was loaded into the syringe (250 μL). The titration was performed at 25 °C with 19 injections of 2 μL each, spaced 120 s apart. The stirring speed was set to 300 rpm. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA, U.S.A.) with a one-site binding model. The experiments were performed in triplicate, and the results are presented as the mean ± SD.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT
